svg.title: Pipeline charts for eight alternating ADD and MUL instructions: 30 cycles without forwarding, 16 with forwarding
svg.text: Without forwarding: 30 cycles. A dependent EX waits until the producer has written back.
Grey = EX (reads registers). Dashed "wait" = stalled in ID.

g.text: With forwarding: 16 cycles. Each EX starts the cycle after the previous EX ends.
